# IPC schema codec, C++ half (ADR-0005). The hand-written MessagePack core and framing live in cpp/;
# the message structs are generated by tools/MikePDF.ProtocolGen into generated/cpp/ and checked in.
add_library(mikepdf_protocol STATIC
  cpp/mikepdf/protocol/msgpack.cpp
  cpp/mikepdf/protocol/codec.cpp
  generated/cpp/mikepdf/protocol/messages.cpp)
target_include_directories(mikepdf_protocol PUBLIC cpp ${MIKEPDF_PROTOCOL_CPP_DIR})
mikepdf_harden(mikepdf_protocol)
